03 · featured project

Voice-Driven 2D to 3D House Plan Generator

A system that converts spoken commands into a 2D floor plan, then automatically extrudes it into a corresponding 3D house model.

Explore the illustrations: zoom, drag to pan, or rotate the image through 360°. Image rotation does not reveal other sides of the house.

render_engine: three.js — output/floor_plan.dxf
$ generate --from voice --mode 2d
# walls extruded from plan geometry
$ pipeline --status
✓ voice command captured
✓ NLP parsed room / dimension intent
✓ 2D floor plan generated
✓ walls extruded → 3D model rendered (three.js)
